row: Specializing in senior dogs, dogs with mobility challenges, nervous or anxious dogs, and dogs who benefit from safe, low-impact exercise. Rescued Tails offers canine hydrofitness and massage therapy at the Canine Wellness Spa inside Barkingham Pet Hotel California in Palm Desert, Ca. Massage therapy may be provided in the comfort of your dog's home. Our state-of-the-art underwater treadmill provides a safe, low-impact way to build strength, improve mobility, increase endurance, and release excess energy. Proudly serving the Greater Palm Desert and Palm Springs areas.
